tasks.completion_summary: T1: handleExplicitStart now persists proxies to stateMgr so autostart-driven proxies survive daemon restart; RED/GREEN TDD with nil-guard regression test.

T2: registered proxy-kind admin entries for explicit proxies via a new daemon-level proxyEntryStore; SCRIPT LIST now merges process-kind and proxy-kind rows so the overlay status bar renders indicators for standalone proxies.

T3: hubHandleProxyStart collapsed into a thin wrapper over handleExplicitStart; MCP tool proxies now get dependency gating (registerProxyDependencies) and admin-surface entries (proxyEntryStore), and the proxy_no_overlay warning moved to handleExplicitStart so every explicit start path surfaces it uniformly.

T6: PROXY STATUS and PROXY LIST response dicts now surface stats.Uptime and stats.TotalRequests as top-level keys. Added formatProxyUptime helper to pre-format time.Duration as string (Go default JSON marshals duration as nanoseconds int; MCP tool expected string via getString). Replan found bug was in handler layer (hub_proxy.go), not proxy.Stats() — which was returning correct values all along. 4 new subtests cover both criteria on both creation paths (MCP ProxyStartWithConfig + autostart handleExplicitStart).
